steps.name: Siege
steps.text: It's really changed around here.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Ruins, corpses, and Originium dust floating from the dead.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: I imagine you Rhodes Islanders don't need me worrying about your protection, being Oripathy specialists and all.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This war has been creating new Infected without end... and life under these circumstances can only make it harder.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: They've been thrown into this chaos without warning, and they may not realize how cruel a fall it is yet. That goes for the pain of their illness, and the scars of war...

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: But they'll know soon enough, and twice over.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: We all have a clear picture of how it infects and festers, how the people die in their confusion, or amass in their hatred.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: And you've seen where that hatred leads, Doctor.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: War's given people a great excuse. Without the veil of daily life, things could get even worse.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Whatever reason it is, we need to stop Theresis.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...And Theresa.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: ...Roger.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: It looks like we'll have to part ways for the moment. So goes our line of work—always piles of things nagging at you to deal with them.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Right. I think I'll be seeing you in a bit.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Stay productive, now.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Bleeding hell, he... he makes my hairs stand on end.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Not even old PC Whitman ever made me feel so sick.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Alright, everyone, chin up. Welcome to the HQ of we merry Glasgow Gangers. I mean, I can guarantee it WAS at least.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Don't know how Baird's been running the gym since we left...

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Siege, Morgan, you not got anything to say?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Indra, love... I think I stepped on something...

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Eh? Probably just someone's pet scarpering for the street aga...

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: The hell is... is that a...?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I've seen already, Doctor. In those illusions from the past, I've seen sights still more tragic than the ones here.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We're here precisely to ensure the situation doesn't unfold that far.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The hatted man led us here, then permitted us to act freely on our own wishes outside of the deal we made. His goal is clear to us.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: He knows we won't be content with letting all this be, and he hopes the people here will credit the Duke he serves with our actions.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But I don't care.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I don't care how the Duke wants to use us. I don't care what kind of prestige she's hoping to rake in.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I don't care if this will impact some other duke's fight for their people's affections, or compel them to act in whatever way.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: All that matters is I cannot let this be.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This isn't some disaster taking place in a country, in a city, in a neighborhood unrelated to us.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This is happening to each and every living person.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Trust has always been a fragile thing, collapsed in a moment, ever harder to rebuild.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Quickly, Doctor. We might not have that many pharmaceuticals on us, but we have to make all the use of them that we can.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: There, that should be okay now.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Sorry, I'm not a professional doctor. This is just some basic first-aid.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We've stabilized your Oripathy symptoms, and stopped your wounds worsening. That's all we can do for now.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You need rest, and supplements. After that, it's down to luck.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Do you need us to bring you home?

steps.name: Maimed Citizen
steps.text: No, no, no need!

steps.name: Maimed Citizen
steps.text: Hunger knocked me out, that's all. Just, was sleeping for a bit on the pavement.

steps.name: Maimed Citizen
steps.text: What... What'll you be wanting? I've got nothing to my name.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We don't want anything.

steps.name: Maimed Citizen
steps.text: N... Nothing?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Go back home, sir.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (Here's some food. Keep it hidden. Don't let anyone else find out.)

steps.name: Maimed Citizen
steps.text: Wh—Who the...?

steps.name: Maimed Citizen
steps.text: Alright, alright. I'll be out of here, then...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (You've gone too long without food. Don't eat too quickly. You need to let your bodily functions recover bit by bit first.)

steps.name: Maimed Citizen
steps.text: Right, got it...

steps.name: Maimed Citizen
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Amiya, we have a lot of people staring at us.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Most of them with ill will.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Two groups are planning their moves and readying Molotovs.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But at the same time, the desperate have seen us too. And the ones hiding themselves in the dark, deathly ill, so have they.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Just the fact we're here might have been enough to relight a spark of hope in them.

options: After a violent collapse, any rebuild demands great care.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That's right, Doctor.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We don't need for the people to trust us, we need them to... reestablish their trust in each other.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That's what underlies a society coming back to life.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Someone's coming.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Doesn't matter. I'm stood right here. I'll stand in front of you.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: This is our street, and we're pulling her back out of this chaos and anger.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Doesn't matter who it is. Bring it on.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Mind yourselves. Here they come.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Hey!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Is that—

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: (Oi, watch you don't fuss about nothing, Hannah. Nearly socked you straight in the gob.)

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: (You lot show off like a circus. You want everyone here targeting you?)

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: (Come on. With me.)

steps.name: Starving Thug
steps.text: They're gonna run!

steps.name: Angry Thug
steps.text: Shit! The Glasgows got in first!

steps.name: Starving Thug
steps.text: Surround 'em!

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Out of the way.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Ms. Ines, don't take them on. Not for now.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I... recognize a few of their lot. It's just the fear and torture's driving them mad.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Nothing they need to pay for with their lives.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: (Head to the alley we used to bunk off at for snooker. Same door as ever.)

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: (Got it.)

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: (Baird, we'll... see you at home.)

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Come with me!

steps.name: Angry Thug
steps.text: Quick! Get a move on, don't lose 'em!

steps.name: Starving Thug
steps.text: I... I haven't eaten for days, I can't run...

steps.name: Angry Thug
steps.text: On your bike and get out of here, then! You'd eat dead people if you had any spine! I'm not your nanny!

steps.name: Angry Thug
steps.text: You wanna go?

steps.name: Red
steps.text: Who are those people?

steps.name: Angry Thug
steps.text: Eh? Who else are they gonna be? It's the Glasgow bastards!

steps.name: Red
steps.text: The Glasgow Gang, are they.

steps.name: Angry Thug
steps.text: Are we getting them together, or am I getting you?

steps.name: Red
steps.text: No, I reckon I've seen them before. And that one in the uniform...

steps.name: Red
steps.text: Things here got more complex than I was predicting.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: I need to move fast.

steps.name: Sarkaz Soldier
steps.text: Is there a bigger ruckus in there today or something? Did a fire start again?

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Should I go take a look, sir?

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: If a fire spreads...

steps.name: Sarkaz Soldier
steps.text: Then it's no skin off your nose, little girl.

steps.name: Sarkaz Soldier
steps.text: Do your own job. Don't let me see anything funny.

steps.name: Sarkaz Soldier
steps.text: No one's going to look out for you here.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: A... Aye-aye, sir!

steps.name: Sarkaz Soldier
steps.text: Sir! What brings you here in person?

steps.name: Sarkaz Soldier
steps.text: There's nothing you need to worry about here, it's all under control!
Paying no heed to the Sarkaz soldier's report, Manfred walks over to the foot of the blockade zone's wall, gazing far off at the buildings within.

steps.name: Sarkaz Soldier
steps.text: Is... Is something off, sir?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: The war continues to proceed smoothly.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Paprika, what have you witnessed in these past days?

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: They've just been—slaughtering each other.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: No, it's not even that, really... they've just been... so scared.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Fear and mistrust divide a people. Pacts, customs and morals all collapse forthwith under extreme conditions.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: The Kazdel of old attested to that.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Kazdel...

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Hence do our two leaders take a stand.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: You mean...?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: What if I were to ask you—what can bind a people?

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Maybe... patience? We can try and win people over, or use our own kindness to move others...

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: I think, as long as you have enough time...

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: She failed.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Any ties that such things build are too frail.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: But he told me. The most efficient thing... is hate.
Manfred throws an indifferent glance at the young mercenary girl, her breaths bound tight by nerves, daring only to stare at the tips of her own shoes.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: You have persistently been sharing your own supplies with those behind the blockade.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: N—No! That was a Sarkaz! I thought...

steps.name: Sarkaz Soldier
steps.text: What?! How could you—

steps.name: Sarkaz Soldier
steps.text: Sarkaz who serve Victoria should make you even more sick!

steps.name: Sarkaz Soldier
steps.text: Sir, I assure you, I will immediately...

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Continue.

steps.name: Sarkaz Soldier
steps.text: ...Sir?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: We cannot have everyone inside dying of starvation yet.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: In time... they will be of great use to the Military Commission.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Not much has changed around here.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Morgan, all your graffiti's still up.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: I'm looking now. My standards must have been terrible back then.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: You haven't got much better, though?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Oh, you wanna go, Hannah?!
As the two argue, Siege and Baird look on, then make brief eye contact, and break into laughter, shaking their heads.
If you overlook the sealed-up entrance, the boarded-up windows and the weariness in their expressions, it might all seem like nothing's changed.
But everyone knows deep inside. 'We haven't changed' is self-consolation at most, a kind of illusion.
Every minute and second that's ever passed has left an unquestionable mark on them.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Long time no see, Baird.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: True that, Vina. Long time no see.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: The fact you're still around and kicking is probably the best news I've had in a long while.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: I've never said die, you know that.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: That I do.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: Vina, I'm... just as happy to see you back here. Happier than you could imagine.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: I always believed you'd come back. We put up the sign for the Slobberknocker together and all, back in the early days.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: Just, it's been hard for me to grin and bear it. In these times.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: And I know you didn't come back just for my sakes.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: Five whole years ago you scrambled out of here... I remember Norport was practically open season already, all those bastards after your neck.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I... wasn't ready then.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I didn't want to tow anyone else into my business. It was leave or nothing.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: So? You're back here now, back on our street. Now you're ready.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: ...I hope I am.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: The Rhodes Islanders want to look for that Sarkaz airship here. I'll be assisting them as a Rhodes operator and all.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: But I've never stopped being a member of the Glasgow Gang.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I'll get you out of this mess. That's my duty to you. Always has been.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: Hah, same as ever, you are, Vina. Not one bit different.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Hah. Just like it used to be, eh.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: Just, there's one thing. I don't know if...

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: Baird, we're skint on supplies as is. Now you bring in all these people.

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: You want everyone to split up once we're done eating? Or are you hoping I'll go rob some blockhouse with security up to here?

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Shut it with that, Cador.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Although our stockpile's definitely...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Please, it's okay. We've brought rations with us. We even have some surplus.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Hmm. Not... the biggest amount, but enough to put us out of dire straits for now.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We can change this zone together.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: As long as we can unite everyone on the plate...

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: Pff. Unite?

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: Listen, Cautus runt, 'unite' is an easy word to toss around. But you lot are more than welcome to try.

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: Fingers crossed... you're what makes the difference.
